summary: TPG RE Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $500M senior secured credit agreement (Term Loan B $400M and Revolving Credit Facility $100M) with Wells Fargo as agent. Proceeds will repay existing debt and fund redemption of a CLO. Interest rates are SOFR-based. The filing is a routine debt financing, not a special situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special category event is present.
